_comment: Reference solution for do-rename-net. See test/gold/do-budget-refusal-pullup.json
for why reference solutions live outside tasks/.
The trap this task sets is propagation. `DATA` appears four times in the
schematic, but only two of them are the net: the others are the microphone's
own pin name inside lib_symbols, which must NOT be renamed — renaming a pin
name breaks the symbol definition while leaving the netlist looking correct.
So the replacement is anchored to `(label "DATA"` rather than the bare word.
A run that renames every occurrence of DATA passes net_present and net_absent
and still corrupts the design. A run that renames one of the two labels leaves
the net split in half. Both are the realistic failures here.
PINOUT.md is written rather than edited because `copperhead init`, this task's
declared setup command, hard-requires kicad-cli and is skipped in a bare
environment. In a complete environment init scaffolds docs/ before the baseline
commit and the correct behaviour is to edit the scaffolded file.

files.docs/PINOUT.md:
# Pinout

Signals on the FFC connector J1.

| Net | Direction | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CLK | in | PDM clock from the host |
| PDM_DATA | out | PDM bitstream from MK1 |
| SELECT | in | Channel select, strapped |

transcript.summary: renamed net label DATA to PDM_DATA on both labels, leaving the MK1 pin name untouched
propagated the rename into the pinout table
